5064.title: Inline edits do not reserve queued messages
5064.rootCauseOneLine: Inline editing creates no server reservation, so automatic claiming can consume the saved payload and remove the unsaved editor.
5064.proposedFix: Atomically admit a server-recognized per-item edit session against dispatch claiming, and release it on Save or Cancel with explicit ownership and recovery semantics.
5064.caveats: Two clean same-agent source reproductions; completion and consumption simulated through actual database functions; no live desktop, daemon, provider delivery, or transport verification. Complete regression test and sanitized output are inline under reports repository policy.
